title: Across the Brooklyn Bridge
content:
From Brooklyn Bridge Park through DUMBO, where Washington Street frames the Manhattan Bridge, then over the Brooklyn Bridge's raised walkway into Manhattan at City Hall Park. The bridge opened in 1883 and was the first to cross the East River.

Demo day: the walk is a simulated route along real streets. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
